columnDescriptions.reporting_committee_id: Literal FEC ID of the reporting committee where that source field identifies a committee. It does not by itself identify the sender or recipient of money.
columnDescriptions.reporting_committee_name: Reporting committee name exactly as supplied by the retained CSV source.
columnDescriptions.counterparty_name: The counterparty's name as reported, without a name-based identity merge.
columnDescriptions.transaction_id: Literal transaction identifier within its source filing/layout scope; not a globally unique transaction or economic-event key.
columnDescriptions.native_sub_id: Literal source sub_id retained separately from typed identity and transaction ID.
columnDescriptions.amount_raw: Literal source value before conversion for amount. Preserves spelling, signs and empty values; the typed value and its status are separate.
columnDescriptions.amount_status: Source-presence or conversion state for amount, distinguishing supported values from NULL, empty, missing or refused interpretation; it does not establish financial eligibility.
columnDescriptions.date_raw: Literal date field of the retained CSV context row before source-specific interpretation.
columnDescriptions.date_status: Conversion state for the reported transaction/context date; distinguishes exact values, source NULL/empty and invalid or unsupported spelling.
columnDescriptions.native_fields_json: Retained native field values for the source row or feed item, including fields beyond the typed mapping.
columnDescriptions.native_row_locator_json: Exact original CSV row and field coordinates retained by the source context.
columnDescriptions.coverage_status: Explicit completeness/retention scope of the context rows; a retained prefix does not become complete source history.
columnDescriptions.current_total_status: Explicit limitation or refusal for current financial totals; historical/context observations are not silently treated as a current population.
columnDescriptions.amount: Exact decimal for the source-reported amount for this record and its amount_kind. Signs are preserved; use the corresponding status and source-specific financial policy before adding observations.
columnDescriptions.reported_date: Date parsed from the date stated for this historical/context observation. NULL requires the source value and conversion status; capture time is not substituted.
columnDescriptions.source_row_ordinal: Native row ordinal supplied by the retained CSV context.

description.label: FEC CSV context observations
description.subject: campaign_finance
description.grain: One physical CSV row exposed by retained collection context.
description.coverage: Sampled. Supported observations from supported retained CSV context rows with exact native fields and addresses. The retained selection is explicit in fec_collections and its source-generation evidence; this declaration does not establish complete FEC history or current publication.
description.summary: One physical CSV row exposed by retained collection context. Preserves source values, amounts and dates under the context's actual coverage status. A complete retained prefix is still not an asserted complete source population or current financial total. Resolve collection_id to fec_collections in the captured source generation and source_context_pointer into its retained context. Context witnesses use their own digest and native coordinates; they do not require a fictional source_record_id. Every row has the amount status `exact`.

columnDescriptions.collection_id: Selected collection label: the file or query the record came from. Together with source_record_id identifies this record; joins fec_collections.collection_id and, for the election cycle, fec_collection_cycles.collection_id.
columnDescriptions.source_family: Caller-selected official FEC source-family identifier, checked against the inventory. Joins fec_source_catalog.source_family; this classification is not independently inferred from source content.
columnDescriptions.profile: Provider reader profile used to interpret the verified input.
columnDescriptions.source_record_id: Provider source-record identity, native API identity, bulk file key or byte-evidenced positional/agency-report observation ID, scoped to collection_id.
columnDescriptions.committee_id: Committee ID as the source reports it (bulk CMTE_ID or the API's committee_id). In transaction files this is the committee that filed the report, not necessarily the one that received the money: a PAC's contribution to a candidate is filed under the PAC's ID, with the recipient in metadata_json OTHER_ID and CAND_ID, and TRANSACTION_TP says which way the money moved. To find money a committee received from other committees, also search OTHER_ID: in the 2025-2026 file a candidate committee's own filings list no direct PAC contributions, so they appear only under each PAC's committee_id, with the candidate in OTHER_ID and CAND_ID (TRANSACTION_TP 24K). May join fec_committees.committee_id. Blanks remain blank; no identifier is inferred from a name or another entity's ID.
columnDescriptions.candidate_id: Literal candidate identifier reported by API metadata or a verified named bulk field such as CAND_ID. Blanks and aggregate codes remain literal; an ID-shaped aggregate value does not establish a person. Names are not converted to identifiers.
columnDescriptions.filing_id: Source-reported sub_id of a filing metadata row when present; not an inferred original-file number. Amendment/current-record meaning remains in native metadata.
columnDescriptions.legal_doc_id: Source-reported legal document identifier when present, retained in its original source scope.
columnDescriptions.audit_case_id: Source-reported audit case identifier when present.
columnDescriptions.source_sha256: Digest pinning the source bytes from which the provider observed this record.
columnDescriptions.source_url: Recorded source URL associated with the observation; this is evidence provenance, not a live availability check.
columnDescriptions.observed_at: Provider observation time when available, distinct from dates reported inside the source record.
columnDescriptions.source_locator_json: JSON source coordinates identifying the original response field, record, file or ZIP member and byte span when supplied. Optional field_mapping pins the selected source header or HTML field dictionary; complete dictionary cells appear in the parent collection's tableFieldDefinitions.
columnDescriptions.metadata_json: Complete provider-native metadata or agency-report record, or literal positional values named by an explicitly selected verified source header or ordered HTML field dictionary. Memo and attribution fields require source-specific inclusion rules; mapping these raw fields does not establish a safe financial total. Header and blank rows retain positional metadata; source_record_json always retains the full native wrapper.
columnDescriptions.assets_json: JSON representation of provider asset references and evidence; an asset reference alone does not establish that its body was downloaded.
columnDescriptions.embedded_bodies_json: JSON representation of provider-embedded body values, retaining their supplied scope.
columnDescriptions.source_record_json: Complete provider source-record serialization, preserving identity, native metadata, assets, bodies and evidence.
